name: EPIC 247518272
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 13, 11.6 solar radii and 1.30 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247518272 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.629168 (16th-84th percentiles 11.356339-12.093628), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247518272: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4892.121 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 247518272 (K2 campaign 13): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2556.640625 (16th-84th percentiles 2525.292969-2589.492188), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 1.14 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,557 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 13, give 1.30 solar masses and 11.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,892 K at its surface.
